Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC timeline & milestones - Acme Industries (next steps & success criteria)

Hi Alice / Bob —

Great to meet you both this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps for the POC so we can get to a kickoff next week: 

Summary of scope
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for multi-tenant prompt routing and 99th percentile latency under your 4k token baseline.
- Environment: 2-week trial against a subset of internal workflows (search & summarization).

Proposed success criteria (attached):
1) End-to-end 95th percentile latency <= 450ms on p99-like load during business hours for 4k tokens.
2) Accuracy benchmark: no more than 8% regression vs. your current baseline on the evaluation prompt set.
3) Throughput: sustained 50 concurrent sessions with <10% error rate.
4) Security: logs and audit events delivered to your S3/KMS integration.

Timeline / milestones
- Kickoff: propose Wed 2026-11-24 or Mon 2026-11-29 (30-45 min)
- Week 1: infra & data access, baseline runs, integrate SDK
- Week 2: tuning, evaluation runs, final readout & next steps
Ownership
- RM (Rishi) — integration & test harness setup
- Infra (Dev Patel) — networking, VPC peering & KMS config
- Marissa — project lead / point-of-contact for scheduling and success criteria sign-off
Requested next actions
- Please confirm the kickoff date that works for you and any changes to the success criteria (see attached POC_Success_Criteria.pdf).
- Share any evaluation prompts / representative workloads by EOD Tues so Rishi can baseline them.
Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.pdf (summary), POC_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (detailed milestones)

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
